description: This file defines a Flask route for health checking in a backend server, utilizing Flask-Smorest's Blueprint and Flask's MethodView for creating a health status endpoint.

classes.name: HealthCheck
classes.description: A Flask MethodView class providing a health check endpoint that returns a simple JSON payload indicating the server is healthy.

methods.name: get(self)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the '/' route, returning a JSON object with message 'Healthy'.

ctags.name: blp
ctags.pattern: /^blp = Blueprint("Healt Check", "health check", url_prefix="\/", description="Health check route"/

fields.name: blp = Blueprint("Healt Check", "health check", url_prefix="\/", description="Health check route"/
